# Ignav Flights

Search airports and flight fares, compare one-way, round-trip, and flexible itineraries, and retrieve airline or travel-agency booking links with Ignav.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ignav-flights/.

## Actions

- **Get Booking Links** (read-only): Get current direct airline or OTA booking links for a recent Ignav fare result or a manually specified one-way/round-trip flight.
- **Search Airports** (read-only): Find supported airport-level IATA codes by code, airport name, city, country, or metro-style query.
- **Search Flexible Fares** (read-only): Search one or two ordered flight legs for multi-city, open-jaw, or other flexible trips.
- **Search One-Way Fares** (read-only): Search complete one-way flight itineraries between two airport-level IATA codes on a future date.
- **Search Round-Trip Fares** (read-only): Search complete round-trip itineraries between two airport-level IATA codes with outbound and return dates.
